title: Matthew Brown: Amentum hangars at Pax River house anomalous material
place_text: Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland

as_told.title: Tweet: Amentum's special-project hangars at Pax River

tellings.quote: Anyways, next time you are visiting the @WashingtonDCYRs, ask for a tour of @NASPaxRiverPAO! Since you have "all the clearances" it shouldn't be an issue for you to get a tour of the special project hangars owned by @amentum_corp (and other fun spaces). Make sure to look up!

plain: Hangars at Naval Air Station Patuxent River, a Navy base in Maryland, run by the contractor Amentum are said to hold "some anomalous stuff", according to the researcher UAPGerb, who says he is passing on what Matthew Brown, a former Defense Department official turned whistleblower, has said. Brown's own words come from a post on X on 6 June 2025, addressed to Elon Musk, telling him that with "all the clearances" he should have no trouble getting a tour of "the special project hangars owned by @amentum_corp (and other fun spaces)", and adding "Make sure to look up!" The post does not say what is in the hangars: that they hold anomalous material is how the tellers read it, and if so, it would mean such material sits at a working Navy base.
